---
title: "Corpus overview"
---

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
read_or_empty <- function(path) if (file.exists(path)) read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA")) else data.frame()
docs <- read_or_empty("data/candidates.csv")
if (!nrow(docs)) docs <- data.frame(year=integer(), title=character(), institution=character(), families=character(), language=character(), matched_concepts=character(), review_status=character(), document_url=character(), relevance_excerpt=character())
split_long <- function(values, ids) {
  out <- lapply(seq_along(values), function(i) { z <- strsplit(ifelse(is.na(values[i]), "", values[i]), "\\|")[[1]]; data.frame(id=ids[i], value=z[nzchar(z)]) })
  if (!length(out) || !sum(lengths(out))) data.frame(id=character(), value=character()) else do.call(rbind, out)
}
safe_min <- function(x) if (length(x <- x[!is.na(x)])) min(x) else "—"
safe_max <- function(x) if (length(x <- x[!is.na(x)])) max(x) else "—"
```

```{r}
cat(sprintf('<div class="row text-center"><div class="col"><h2>%d</h2><p>Logical documents</p></div><div class="col"><h2>%d</h2><p>Language versions</p></div><div class="col"><h2>%d</h2><p>Retained documents</p></div><div class="col"><h2>%d</h2><p>Institutions</p></div><div class="col"><h2>%s–%s</h2><p>Observed years</p></div></div>', length(unique(docs$document_id)), nrow(docs), length(unique(docs$document_id[docs$review_status %in% c("retain","include")])), length(unique(docs$institution[nzchar(docs$institution)])), safe_min(docs$year), safe_max(docs$year)))
```

## Documents by year

```{r}
if (nrow(docs) && any(!is.na(docs$year))) ggplot(docs[!is.na(docs$year),], aes(year)) + geom_bar(fill="#2b6f8a") + scale_x_continuous(breaks=scales::breaks_pretty()) + labs(x=NULL,y="Documents") + theme_minimal() else cat("No dated documents yet.")
```

## Families over time

```{r}
fam <- split_long(docs$families, seq_len(nrow(docs))); if (nrow(fam)) fam$year <- docs$year[as.integer(fam$id)]
if (nrow(fam) && any(!is.na(fam$year))) ggplot(fam[!is.na(fam$year),], aes(year, fill=value)) + geom_histogram(binwidth=1, position="stack") + labs(x=NULL,y="Documents",fill="Family") + theme_minimal() else cat("Not enough data yet.")
```

## Institution and language versions

```{r}
if (nrow(docs)) {
  p1 <- ggplot(docs, aes(x=reorder(institution, institution, function(x) -length(x)))) + geom_bar(fill="#5b8e7d") + coord_flip() + labs(x=NULL,y="Documents") + theme_minimal()
  p2 <- ggplot(docs, aes(language)) + geom_bar(fill="#b56576") + labs(x=NULL,y="Version records") + theme_minimal()
  print(p1); print(p2)
} else cat("No documents yet.")
```

## Concepts over time

```{r}
con <- split_long(docs$matched_concepts, seq_len(nrow(docs))); if (nrow(con)) con$year <- docs$year[as.integer(con$id)]
if (nrow(con) && any(!is.na(con$year))) ggplot(con[!is.na(con$year),], aes(year, colour=value)) + geom_freqpoly(binwidth=1, linewidth=.8) + labs(x=NULL,y="Documents",colour="Concept") + theme_minimal() else cat("No coded concepts yet.")
```

## Family-by-concept heatmap

```{r}
if (nrow(fam) && nrow(con)) {
  pairs <- merge(fam, con, by="id"); counts <- as.data.frame(table(pairs$value.x, pairs$value.y)); counts <- counts[counts$Freq>0,]
  if (nrow(counts)) print(ggplot(counts, aes(Var2, Var1, fill=Freq)) + geom_tile() + scale_fill_viridis_c() + labs(x="Concept",y="Family",fill="Documents") + theme_minimal() + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45,hjust=1))) else cat("No co-occurrences yet.")
} else cat("No co-occurrences yet.")
```

## Search and filter documents

```{r results='asis'}
esc <- function(x) { x <- gsub("&","&amp;",x,fixed=TRUE); x <- gsub("<","&lt;",x,fixed=TRUE); gsub(">","&gt;",x,fixed=TRUE) }
if (nrow(docs)) {
  filters <- list(year=sort(unique(docs$year[!is.na(docs$year)])), institution=sort(unique(docs$institution)), family=sort(unique(fam$value)), language=sort(unique(docs$language)), concept=sort(unique(con$value)), status=sort(unique(docs$review_status)))
  cat('<input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Search titles and excerpts…" class="form-control mb-2">')
  for (nm in names(filters)) cat(sprintf('<select id="f-%s" class="form-select d-inline-block mb-2" style="width:auto"><option value="">All %s</option>%s</select> ', nm, nm, paste(sprintf('<option>%s</option>', esc(as.character(filters[[nm]]))), collapse="")))
  cat('<div class="table-responsive"><table id="corpus-table" class="table table-striped table-sm"><thead><tr><th>Year</th><th>Title</th><th>Institution</th><th>Families</th><th>Language</th><th>Concepts</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>')
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(docs))) cat(sprintf('<tr data-year="%s" data-institution="%s" data-family="%s" data-language="%s" data-concept="%s" data-status="%s"><td>%s</td><td><a href="%s">%s</a><br><small>%s</small></td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td><td>%s</td></tr>', docs$year[i], esc(docs$institution[i]), esc(docs$families[i]), esc(docs$language[i]), esc(docs$matched_concepts[i]), esc(docs$review_status[i]), docs$year[i], esc(docs$document_url[i]), esc(docs$title[i]), esc(substr(docs$relevance_excerpt[i],1,180)), esc(docs$institution[i]), esc(docs$families[i]), esc(docs$language[i]), esc(docs$matched_concepts[i]), esc(docs$review_status[i])))
  cat('</tbody></table></div>')
} else cat("No candidates yet. Run the limited crawler.")
```

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>{const controls=[...document.querySelectorAll('#q,[id^="f-"]')]; const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('#corpus-table tbody tr')]; function apply(){const q=(document.querySelector('#q')?.value||'').toLowerCase(); rows.forEach(r=>{let ok=r.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q); document.querySelectorAll('[id^="f-"]').forEach(s=>{if(s.value){const key=s.id.slice(2); ok=ok && (r.dataset[key]||'').split('|').includes(s.value)}});r.hidden=!ok})} controls.forEach(x=>x.addEventListener('input',apply));});
</script>
```
